headline: Maui Planning Commission - South Maui Plan

meeting.body: Maui Planning Commission - South Maui Plan
meeting.summary: Reviewing the South Maui Community Plan, the Maui Planning Commission voted down two map motions for the Maui Research and Technology Park.
meeting.recap: The Maui Planning Commission met to review the South Maui Community Plan.[[0:00:40]] The planning director said special purpose district is absolutely inappropriate for the park.[[0:42:46]] A second motion to designate the whole park special purpose district also failed.[[1:23:53]] The director said the community plan is not the right tool to stop building on undeveloped land at risk from sea level rise.[[1:54:33]] A commissioner asked to hold that item until the commission understands takings (when a rule leaves private land with no economic use).[[2:05:44]] A commissioner proposed delaying a proposed industrial project outside the growth boundary.[[2:08:01]] The commission will resume its review in January.[[2:10:36]]
decided: The commission flagged the open space designations for undeveloped parcels in the sea level rise area to revisit later.
meeting.next: The director said the department could talk with the research park's landowner if the commission takes up the map again later.
